info.title: SOS App — Backend API
info.description: Snap or Slap challenge app backend API. All endpoints return JSON. Most application endpoints currently use ?user_id=UUID for the mobile/backend contract.

get.description: Returns server status and uptime. No auth required.

post.description: Create account with email, password, username. Returns JWT tokens.
Authenticate with email + password. Returns JWT tokens.

get.description: Check if a username is available. No auth required. Test in browser: /api/auth/check-username?username=cool_user

post.description: Exchange refresh_token for new access_token. Old refresh_token is revoked (rotation).
Revoke refresh token. Access token expires naturally (15min).

get.description: Get profile by user_id query param. Test in browser: /api/users/me?user_id=UUID

patch.description: Update display_name, bio, is_private. Requires user_id query param.

get.description: Search users by username prefix. Test: /api/users/search?q=maya&user_id=YOUR_UUID
Paginated list of accepted friends. Test: /api/friends?user_id=UUID

post.description: Send a friend request to another user.

409.description: Already friends or request already sent

put.description: Respond to an incoming friend request.

get.description: Incoming pending requests. Test: /api/friends/requests/pending?user_id=UUID
Privacy-aware profile. Friends see full data; strangers see limited info. Test: /api/users/TARGET_UUID/profile?user_id=YOUR_UUID

Get paginated list of challenges the user has joined. Supports status filter.

Test: /api/challenges?user_id=ALICE_UUID&status=active

post.description: Create a challenge. Creator becomes the host automatically. Challenge starts in 'formation' status.

get.description: Get full challenge info including members list. If user_id provided, also returns the viewer's membership info.

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: Current viewer ID (optional, to get my_membership)

patch.description: Update challenge settings. Only the host can edit, and only while status is 'formation'.

400.description: Validation error or challenge not in formation

404.description: Challenge not found or not the host

delete.description: Delete a formation challenge or cancel an active challenge. Only the host can perform this action. Completed/failed challenges cannot be deleted.

404.description: Challenge not found or not the host

post.description: Host invites friends to a formation challenge. Only the host can invite. Invitees must be friends. Skips users already in the challenge.

userIds.description: Array of friend user IDs to invite

400.description: Validation error or invitee not a friend

409.description: Challenge not in formation or no slots available

post.description: Accept an invitation to join a challenge. Must have been invited and challenge must be in formation.

409.description: Challenge not in formation or full

get.description: View invited members for a challenge. Browser-testable GET endpoint.

post.description: Decline an invitation to a challenge. Must have been invited.

put.description: Toggle is_ready for an accepted member. Only works during formation. Returns readiness count.

get.description: View all accepted members and their ready status. Browser-testable.

post.description: Leave a formation challenge. Host cannot leave (must cancel instead). Only works during formation.

400.description: Host cannot leave or challenge is active

get.description:
Search/browse public formation challenges that are not full. Optionally exclude challenges user is already in. Browser-testable.

Test: /api/challenges/public?q=wake&user_id=UUID

parameters.name: user_id
parameters.description: Exclude challenges user is already in

post.description:
Submit a check-in for the current cycle. Auto-calculates cycle number from challenge start_at.

Test: POST with { "caption": "Day 4 done!" }

409.description: Challenge not active / already checked in

get.description:
Paginated list of all check-ins with user info. Filter by member_id. Browser-testable.

Test: /api/challenges/{id}/checkins?page=1&limit=10

View all members' check-in status for the current cycle with countdown to reset. Browser-testable.

Test: /api/challenges/{id}/checkins/today

Aggregated stats: completion rate, top performer, per-member breakdown. Browser-testable.

Test: /api/challenges/{id}/stats

post.description:
Send a nudge notification to a member who hasn't checked in. Rate limited: 1 nudge per target per day per challenge.

Requires user_id query param (the nudger).

400.description: Cannot nudge self / target already checked in

403.description: Both users must be accepted members

get.description:
View recent nudges for a member in a challenge. Browser-testable.

Test: /api/challenges/{id}/nudge/{memberId}
Browser-testable endpoint that returns info about a cron job without executing it. No auth needed.

post.description: Execute a cron job. Requires Authorization: Bearer <CRON_SECRET> header. Jobs: formation-transition (transitions formation challenges to active/cancelled), heart-deduction (processes daily heart deductions for active challenges).

get.description: Browser-testable endpoint that returns challenge status/cancel info including final_stats if available.

post.description: Host cancels an active challenge. Creates a completion snapshot and notifies all members. Only the challenge host (creator) can cancel.

403.description: Not the host or challenge not found

get.description: Returns user info, stats, earned badges, locked badges, and recent activities. Browser-testable.
Returns user activities with pagination. Optionally filter by type. Browser-testable.
Returns lightweight user statistics. Browser-testable.

post.description: Forces recalculation of user stats from source data (checkins, challenges, streak). Upserts the user_stats row.
Change user password. Verifies current password, hashes new one, revokes all refresh tokens.
Checks badge conditions against user stats and awards any newly earned badges. Creates activity and notification for each badge earned.

awarded.description: List of newly awarded badge slugs

get.description: Returns paginated notifications for the user. Optional filters: is_read (true/false), category (social/challenge/system). Category maps: social = friend_request, friend_accepted; challenge = challenge_invite, challenge_start, heart_lost, nudge; system = badge_earned.

put.description: Mark specific notifications as read by IDs, or mark all as read with mark_all=true. Idempotent — already-read notifications return updated_count=0.

notification_ids.description: Specific notification IDs to mark as read

mark_all.description: Set true to mark all notifications as read

delete.description: Delete a specific notification. Only the owner can delete their notification.

404.description: Notification not found or not owned by user

get.description: Lightweight endpoint for home screen widget. Returns current streak, active challenges with today's check-in status, and unread notification count.
Returns notifications that have not been shown to the user yet (shown_at IS NULL). After retrieval, marks them as shown. Used for overlay/popup display on app open. Returns oldest first.

Returns detailed history for a finished challenge (completed/failed/cancelled). Includes result banner, final stats, member stats, gallery preview, and recreate eligibility. Returns 409 if challenge is still active or in formation.

result_banner.description: Display banner based on challenge outcome

final_stats.description: Final stats JSONB snapshot (totalCheckins, avgCompletion, etc.)

recreate_eligible.description: True if challenge ended within 90 days and not already recreated

post.description: Creates a new challenge by cloning settings from a finished challenge. Sets parent_challenge_id. Can override title, duration, etc. Optionally reinvites specified users (must be friends).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Old challenge ID to recreate from

reinvite_user_ids.description: User IDs to reinvite (must be friends)

challenge.description: Newly created challenge with parent_challenge_id set

400.description: Missing user_id or reinvite user is not a friend

403.description: User was not a member of old challenge

409.description: Old challenge is still active (not finished)

get.summary: List finished challenges with lifetime stats
get.description: Returns user's finished challenges (completed/failed/cancelled) with lifetime stats from user_stats table. Supports pagination and result filter.

parameters.name: result
parameters.description: Filter by result type. success=completed, game_over=failed, cancelled=cancelled

post.description: Checks if user's current streak hits a milestone (7, 14, 30, 60, 100, 365 days). Creates notification and activity if milestone hit and not already triggered.

reason.description: Why milestone was not triggered (e.g., 'Already triggered this milestone')

description.example: 30 days of waking up early! Snap a photo of your alarm clock.

UpdateChallengeDto.description: All fields optional. Only allowed when challenge status is 'formation'.

method.example: POST with Authorization: Bearer <CRON_SECRET> to execute

result.description: Job-specific result data. For formation-transition: { activated: string[], cancelled: string[] }. For heart-deduction: { processed: [...], skipped: number }.

final_stats.description: Completion snapshot with member_stats, total_checkins, top_performer_id, hearts_remaining, actual_steps_completed, danger_zones
